title: Tsiolkovsky Rocket Equation under Gravity

variables.v(t): Rocket instantaneous vertical velocity at time t
variables.u_{\\text{ex}}: Constant relative exhaust speed of expelled gas
variables.m_0: Initial gross mass of rocket with fuel
variables.m(t): Instantaneous mass of rocket at time t

assumptions: Constant exhaust speed u_ex relative to rocket
validity_conditions: Valid during powered burn phase t <= t_burnout
common_misuse: Using natural logarithm of m/m0 instead of m0/m
Forgetting the -gt gravity tax term in vertical climb
source_provenance: HCV1 Ch 9 p. 163 eq. 9.18; HRW Ch 9 p. 256; UP Ch 8 p. 291
